> Civil engineering laboratory testing equipment supplier and certified land surveying consultancy headquartered in Prahladnagar, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.

## Core Land Surveying Services (Unique Survey)
- [Counter Survey (Contour Survey)](https://uecivil.com/services/contour-survey): 0.25m, 0.5m, and 1.0m elevation contouring (±2–5 mm RL accuracy), slope analysis, AutoCAD .DWG/.DXF deliverables, 3D TIN surface, and cut-and-fill earthwork volume reports.
- [Land Topography Survey](https://uecivil.com/services/topography-survey): Full ground feature pickup (boundaries, structures, trees, poles, utilities, drains) via Reflectorless Total Station and RTK DGPS with .DWG and Google Earth .KMZ outputs.
- [Point Marking & Boundary Demarcation](https://uecivil.com/services/point-marking): Sub-centimeter RTK GNSS & Total Station correlation against Village Form 7/12, Tippan, DILR sheets, and TP Final Plot maps with physical corner pegging and boundary pillars.
- [DGPS & RTK Geodetic Survey](https://uecivil.com/services/dgps-survey): Multi-constellation GNSS satellite positioning (±8 mm + 1 ppm RTK), TBM concrete pillar fixing, WGS-84/UTM coordinate sheets, and GIS .SHP deliverables.
- [Drone / UAV Aerial Mapping](https://uecivil.com/services/drone-survey): 2–5 cm GSD orthomosaic GeoTIFF maps, DSM/DTM/DEM elevation models, .LAS 3D point clouds, and stockpile/quarry volumetrics tied to DGPS GCPs.
- [Plot Layout Setting Out & Subdivision](https://uecivil.com/services/layout-demarcation): Translating approved architectural / NA layout plans onto ground—internal roads, plot corners, and building column grids.
- [Road, Highway & Pipeline Alignment](https://uecivil.com/services/road-alignment): Longitudinal (L-Section) and Cross-Section (X-Section at 10m/20m intervals) profiling, curve staking, and Right-of-Way (ROW) mapping.

---

## Civil Engineering Laboratory Testing Equipment (Unique Engineering)
All equipment conforms to applicable IS (Bureau of Indian Standards), BS, and ASTM test specifications with warranty and calibration support.
- [Cement, Concrete & Aggregate Testing](https://uecivil.com/products?category=cement-concrete): Compression Testing Machines (CTM 2000kN & 3000kN Digital/Analogue per IS:516 & IS:14858), Cast Iron Cube Moulds (150mm), Slump Cone Apparatus (IS:7320), Aggregate Impact Value (AIV), Los Angeles Abrasion, Rebound Hammer.
- [Soil & Geotechnical Testing](https://uecivil.com/products?category=soil-testing): Direct Shear Apparatus, California Bearing Ratio (CBR per IS:2720 Part 16 / ASTM D1883), Proctor Compaction, Casagrande Liquid Limit, Core Cutter, Sand Replacement Apparatus.
- [Bitumen & Asphalt Testing](https://uecivil.com/products?category=bitumen-testing): Digital & Standard Bitumen Penetrometer (IS:1203), Ring & Ball Softening Point (IS:1205), Ductility Testing Machine (IS:1208), Marshall Stability Apparatus, Bitumen Centrifuge Extractor.
- [Survey & Measuring Instruments](https://uecivil.com/products?category=survey-instruments): Electronic Total Stations (1"/2"), Sokkia B40A & Bosch Auto Level Kits, Digital Theodolites, RTK DGPS Receivers, Prisms, Levelling Staves, Aluminum Tripods.
- [Construction Machinery](https://uecivil.com/products?category=construction-machinery): Laboratory Concrete Pan Mixers, Motorized Sieve Shakers, Core Cutting Machines, Thermostatic Cube Curing Tanks.
- [Safety Products & Site PPE](https://uecivil.com/products?category=safety-products): ISI Safety Helmets, High-Visibility Reflective Jackets, Steel-Toe Safety Shoes.

## Engineering Guides & Direct Answer Hub (AEO/GEO)
- [All Engineering Guides & FAQ](https://uecivil.com/guides): Survey comparison tables, IS/ASTM standards matrix, and buyer FAQs.
- [Counter Survey & Cut-Fill Guide](https://uecivil.com/guides/contour-survey-cut-fill-guide): Contour intervals (0.25m–1.0m), accuracy tolerances, and earthwork volume methods.
- [Point Marking & 7/12 Revenue Demarcation Guide](https://uecivil.com/guides/point-marking-7-12-demarcation-gujarat): Correlating 7/12, Tippan, and TP schemes in Gujarat.
- [Compression Testing Machine (CTM) Buyer Guide](https://uecivil.com/guides/compression-testing-machine-ctm-buyer-guide): 2000 kN vs. 3000 kN selection per IS:516 and IS:14858.
- [Civil Engineering Site & NABL Lab Setup Checklist](https://uecivil.com/guides/civil-engineering-lab-setup-checklist-india): Mandatory apparatus by project type (Building, RMC, Highway, College).
